# `analytics` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/analytics.md).

## Activation

An operator switches this module on and off on **/platform/modules**. The choice is the setting `analytics.enabled`, and it defaults to **on**.

## Dependencies

| Module | Binding | What it means |

| `auth` | yes | installs and migrates after it, and an operator cannot switch it off underneath this module |
